Title: Catalog lists the products with their prices
Steps: Open the app
Expected result: Products screen shows Backpack $29.99, Bike Light $9.99, Bolt T-Shirt $15.99, Fleece Jacket $49.99 and more below

Title: Sort by price, low to high
Steps: Tap the sort button; choose "Price - Ascending"
Expected result: Cheapest first: Onesie $7.99, Bike Light $9.99, then $15.99 items

Title: Sort by name, Z to A
Steps: Tap the sort button; choose "Name - Descending"
Expected result: Test.allTheThings() first, then Onesie, Fleece Jacket, Bolt T-Shirt

Title: Sort menu offers four options
Steps: Tap the sort button
Expected result: Name Ascending/Descending and Price Ascending/Descending

Title: Product page shows the product and an Add To Cart button
Steps: Tap "Sauce Labs Backpack"
Expected result: Name, price, highlights and an Add To Cart button

Title: A chosen colour is carried to the cart
Steps: Open the Backpack; choose the blue circle; Add To Cart; open the cart
Expected result: Cart row shows the blue colour

Title: Added product appears in the cart with the right total
Steps: Add the Backpack; open the cart
Expected result: Cart badge 1; "1 item"; total $29.99

Title: Quantity 3 chosen on the product page
Steps: Open the Backpack; tap + twice; Add To Cart; open the cart
Expected result: Badge 3; "3 items"; total $89.97

Title: Changing the quantity in the cart updates the total
Steps: In the cart tap + then -
Expected result: "2 items" $59.98, then "1 item" $29.99

Title: Minus at quantity 1 removes the item
Steps: Add the Backpack; open the cart; tap -
Expected result: Item removed and the empty cart shown
Actual result: Item removed at once. There is no confirmation and no undo (noted, not a defect: it is a common pattern)

Title: Remove item empties the cart
Steps: Add the Backpack; open the cart; tap Remove Item
Expected result: Product gone; checkout button gone

Title: Two products add up, with shipping at review
Steps: Add Backpack and Bike Light; go through checkout to the review screen

Title: Empty cart message
Steps: Open the cart with nothing added
Expected result: A message and a Go Shopping button

Title: Checkout asks for login and accepts a valid user
Steps: Cart > Proceed To Checkout; log in as bob@example.com / 10203040
Expected result: Login screen, then the address form

Title: Empty login form is refused
Steps: Menu > Log In; tap Login with nothing entered
Expected result: "Username is required"

Title: Wrong password is refused with a clear message
Steps: bob@example.com with a wrong password
Expected result: "Provided credentials do not match any user in this service."

Title: Locked-out user is refused
Steps: alice@example.com / 10203040
Expected result: "Sorry, this user has been locked out."

Title: The typed password is hidden
Steps: Menu > Log In; type a password
Expected result: Shown as dots

Title: Log out asks for confirmation in correct wording
Steps: Menu > Log Out
Expected result: Confirmation dialog with correct wording
Actual result: Reads "Are you sure you sure you want to logout?"

Title: After log out, checkout asks for login again
Steps: Log in; log out; add an item; Proceed To Checkout
Expected result: Login screen
Actual result: Not executed: the session stopped at the log-out dialog

Title: Empty shipping address is refused with a message per field
Steps: On the address form tap To Payment with nothing entered
Expected result: Five "Please provide your ..." messages; stays on the address step

Title: A zip code made of symbols is refused
Steps: Enter a valid address but zip "!!!???"; tap To Payment
Expected result: Error on the zip field; stays on the address step

Title: A full name made only of digits is refused
Steps: Full Name "12345", other fields valid; tap To Payment
Expected result: Error on the name field

Title: The address form can be completed with the keyboard open
Steps: Type into Full Name and Address Line 1 with the on-screen keyboard open
Expected result: The form scrolls so the next fields stay visible
Actual result: Keyboard and the footer cover the other fields; the form did not scroll

Title: A card number that fails the checksum is refused
Steps: Card 4111 1111 1111 1112, valid date and code; tap Review Order
Expected result: Stays on the payment step

Title: An expired card is refused with a message
Steps: Card 4111 1111 1111 1111, expiry 01/20, code 123; tap Review Order
Expected result: Refused, with a message about the expiry date
Actual result: Refused (stays on the payment step) but no message is shown anywhere

Title: A 1-digit security code is refused
Steps: Valid card and expiry, security code "1"; tap Review Order
Expected result: Refused: a security code has 3 or 4 digits

Title: The review screen hides most of the card number
Steps: Complete address and payment; open the review screen
Expected result: Only the last four digits are shown
Actual result: The full 16-digit card number is shown

Title: Review total equals the items plus shipping
Steps: One Backpack through to the review screen

Title: A customer can buy a product from catalog to confirmation
Steps: Add the Backpack; checkout; log in; address; card; review; Place Order
Expected result: "Checkout Complete" then back to the catalog

Title: After an order the cart is empty and the badge is cleared
Steps: Complete an order; Continue Shopping
Expected result: Catalog shown; no count on the cart icon

Title: Back from the confirmation screen does not allow another order
Steps: Complete an order; on the confirmation screen press the Android Back button
Expected result: The catalog, or the confirmation again. Never a way to place an order
Actual result: A review screen with "No elements in the cart.", a blank address and card, total $5.99 and an active Place Order button

Title: About shows the app version
Steps: Menu > About
Expected result: Version and build

Title: Reset App State clears the cart
Steps: Add an item; Menu > Reset App State
Expected result: Cart emptied
Actual result: Not executed: the session did not get past the open menu (inconclusive)

Title: Smoke path on iOS
Steps: Run TC-001, 005, 007, 014 and 030 on an iOS device or simulator
Expected result: All pass
Actual result: Not executed: no iOS device or simulator was used

Title: Smoke path on other Android versions and screen sizes
Steps: Repeat the smoke path on Android 12 to 15, a small phone and a tablet
Expected result: All pass

Title: Rotating the screen during checkout keeps the entered data
Steps: Fill the address; rotate; continue
Expected result: Entries kept

Title: Interruptions: a call, a notification, loss of network
Steps: Interrupt checkout with each; return to the app
Expected result: State kept, clear message when offline
